W.note: Slow 1.5s exhale-out and a pointer-following bloom make a rich, lingering glow on dark, with focus ring, active state and a thorough reduced-motion block.

X.note: Gradient sweep with soft overshoot and glow is pleasant and legible, but the effect is more of a polished shift than a truly ethereal bloom.

Y.note: Pink-to-cyan aurora halo blooms behind a white pill and fades slowly, very ethereal, with good focus and reduced-motion handling, though the glow is heavy at rest-to-hover contrast.

Z.note: Subtle pastel veil with overshoot bloom is tasteful and legible but the change is faint, and reduced-motion just shortens durations.
